headline: Four Sectors Keep the Strategic Line Aflame
war_summary: Since the last edition, Fisherman’s Row has sharpened into the liveliest fresh pressure point: its rolling tally stands at 46 ownership events, including 16 in the latest two hours, while Eidolo and Dankana Post remain prominent. Weathered Expanse has eased slightly from its earlier 52-event count but still records 48 for the day and four recent actions, with Frostmarch and Wightwalk foremost. Stlican Shelf likewise remains contested at 44 events, though only three came in the latest two hours; Breaker Town continues to dominate the movement, amid four Warden and five Colonial holdings. Callahan’s Passage has climbed to 24 events, eight of them recent, chiefly around The Crumbling Passage and The Latch; eight bases are Warden-held and two stand neutral. Linn Mercy retains eight events but has gone quiet in the latest two-hour window despite sharply rising casualty rates. Mooring County has slipped to nine events and reports no fresh ownership movement, while Nevish Line shows nine events and heavy, accelerating fighting without a recent flip. Most other sectors remain still.
